h: Torah Repairs the Soul Across Three Worlds

p: In the holy Zohar (beginning of this parashah):
"Come and see: the words of the Torah
And in the gloss of Rabbi Chaim Vital:
the Chamber of the Holy of Holies;
"they are lofty" — from the side of Yetzirah,
"they are sweet" — from the side of Asiyah,
which is called sweet honey, etc.
And above, at the beginning of Parashas Korach,
וּפֵירֵשׁ שָׁם בְּהַגָּהַת רַבִּי חַיִּים וִיטַאל
and Rabbi Chaim Vital explained there in his gloss:
"lofty" — in the secret of the Torah of Beriah,
where there are 310 worlds in the Throne;
310 is the gematria of "yekar," precious, etc.
שֶׁשָּׁם מְדַבֵּר בְּמִי שֶׁלֹּא קִלְקֵל כְּלָל
that there it speaks of one who never spoiled anything at all,
who merit the Torah of Atzilus,
וְשָׁם אֵין שׁוּם מִיעוּט רַע גַּם כֵּן
and there is not even a small amount of evil there,
שֶׁלֹּא יוּכַל הַיֵּצֶר הָרַע לְקַלְקֵל כְּלָל
such that the yetzer hara cannot spoil anything at all.
And here it speaks of one who has spoiled,
And this is why he lists "they are holy"
the Chamber of the Holy of Holies:
which is from the world of Beriah,
and there is only a minority of evil;
and this one merits to repair
so that it be entirely good.
And this is what the gloss mentioned above says,
"the Chamber of the Holy of Holies":
that is, there the Kohen Gadol entered
that he entered the innermost Sanctuary
and saw the King of kings
that is, one merits to repair at the root,
this is the spirit of Mashiach
where the world of the angels is,
וְהוּא נֶגֶד מַה שֶּׁאָמַר שָׁם בְּפָרָשַׁת קֹרַח
and this corresponds to what it says there in Parashas Korach,
is from the world of Yetzirah,
and there it is half good and half evil;
one merits to repair "the heart of the fool,"
the half that is evil too,
so that it be in holiness.
"They are sweet" — from the side of Asiyah:
although there is only a minority of good there,
which are from the world of Asiyah,
through the reasons of the Torah
is as if he stands every day
for they merited to repair all the blemish of the serpent,
and the yetzer hara was nullified;
וְחָזַר רַק עַל יְדֵי הָעֵרֶב רַב
and it returned only through the Erev Rav,
who were from the nations of the world:
כֵּיוָן שֶׁיֵּשׁ מְצִיאוּת מֵרָע עוֹד אֶצְלָם
since evil still existed among them,
it could again enter the heart of Yisrael
הַיְינוּ תּוֹרָה שֶׁבִּכְתָב וְתוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
that is, the Written Torah and the Oral Torah;
and that is the Oral Torah;
we call it the Oral Torah."
which is "dina" with the letters reversed
that the Men of the Great Assembly added.
to repair the blemish of the serpent
and of the one who rides upon the serpent;
for this is the root of the passage of the Parah,
